about: The First Question - QURAN: the shot list and story events, shared by the picture (engine/src/scenes/quran001/timeline.ts) and the sound (engine/tools/mix_quran001.py). A shot starts at its phrase's caption ('phrase': index into timing.json) or at a time in seconds ('at'); the video ends in the breath after 19:63 (timing.json guide.recitationEnd); the end card is an overlay that crossfades in over its last cardFadeSeconds. Shots are 1-4 s each (11-61 s: a little life story). Events: seconds, or {phrase, plus} = that phrase's voice start + plus.

shots.why: neglected: city at night, walking with his phone glowing
prayer and pursued desires: busy at the desk
the warning: dark, cold light, slow push-in
05:12: the alarm glows on the nightstand; he stirs in bed
he turns the phone face-down
he sits up on the edge of the bed and gets up
wudu at the basin, water splashing (the wash corner)
out of the front door into the blue pre-dawn street
a friend waiting under the lamp joins him; they walk to the masjid together
at the masjid door they step out of their sandals
standing in a row of worshippers, shoulder to shoulder (takbir)
the row in ruku, side view
the row in sujood, low side view
after the prayer an old man drops his bags
he picks them up and carries them with him
the garden courtyard: kids running round the fountain, a cat drinking
their ball rolls to him; he picks it up and tosses it back
night: he prays alone in his room by lamp-light (the unseen)
sujood, then sitting, close and low
sunrise time-lapse outside his house: the camera tilts up from his lit window past the rooftops to the sky turning gold, birds crossing
he opens the window and the morning light falls on him
morning street: he waves to the shopkeeper, who waves back
a brother at the masjid door: they embrace
a handshake with a friend; kids run past
breakfast at sunrise with his father and little brother: bread, dates, tea
match cut to sunset: a shared meal on a floor mat with friends
he reads the Quran under the masjid lamp; a boy sits by him
he points along the page, teaching the boy
those who were fearing of Allah: the crane up to the star mark; the end card crossfades in over the last 1.5 s (inside the length)
